tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Supply, Erection, Electrification and Commissioning of 30HP or suitable HP Centrifugal pumpset along with allied accessories to existing WTP at Krishna nagar, Pandavapura town under SFC grants of TMC, Pandavapura town for the year 2025-26 & 2026-27

itemList.description: Pumps:Supply & delivery at site Kirloskar / Sam Turbo / TEXMO / Jyothi / M &P / WPIL / Aquatex / Flow more make or any other make approved by the Board horizontal split case centrifugal pump conforming to the latest ISS 1520 & ISS 5120 and the following descrption: a) Duty condition: Capable of delivering of 48 LPS/173 cum/hr of Treated water against a total head of  30 mtrs. (including a suction lift of 3 mtrs),b) Speed: Duty condition should be met at 1450 RPM, c) Shutt off head: Min 110% & Max 130% of the specified head. d) Material of construction: i) Casing - cast Iron, ii) Impellor -  Bronze / CF8M,iii) Shaft-  SS 410, iv) Stuffing Box - Graphite Asbestos packing, v) Casing wear rings -  Bronze / SS, vi) Gland - Cast Iron, viii) Shaft sleeve -  Bronze / SS, e) Driving end bearing: Grease lubricated roller/ball/journal bearing, f) Non driving end bearing: Grease lubricated deep groove ball bearing or journal bearing.) Coupling: Suitable size vibration proof flexible coupling with coupling guard, as recommended by the manufacturer of pump for coupling to motor.) Base plate: Heavy duty common CI/MS base plate for pump and  Base plate: Heavy duty common CI/MS base plate for pump and motor with suitable 'C' section channels, plates, bolts & nuts etc.,complete with all lead and lift as directed by the EIC.

Motor:30 HP/ 22 KW of Elgi / Kirloskar / Alstom / Crompton Greaves / ABB / Marathon make or any other make approved by the Board horizontal foot mounted TEFC, squirrel cage induction motor for continuous duty conforming to ISS 4691 and ISS 325 for operation on 3 ph, 50 Hz. 440 volts. a) Protection: IP 23, b) Insulation:'F' class, c) Ambient temperature: 45 degree celsius, d) Cushion: 10 % more than power required by the pump and capable of providing rated output up to + or - 10% voltage variation and + or - 3% frequency variation or combination of Both, e) Driving end bearing: Grease lubricated roller bearing, f) Non driving end bearing: Grease lubricated ball bearing etc., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the EIC.

Erection of pumpsets:Formation of suitable block machine foundation in RCC 1:2:4 or by core cutting arrangements using necessary required materials such as cement, sand, jelly etc., complete including necessary earth work excavation, refilling curing etc., complete. Erection of the pumpset mounted on the common base plate on the above foundation using the required materials such as foundation bolts, key locks, self inter locking bolts, washers etc., complete. Levelling, aligning of the pumpsets on the foundation. etc., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the EIC..

Laying and jointing of MS pipes and specials:Cutting, laying and jointing of existing MS pipes and specials for suction & delivery connections of the pump using suitable size bolts, nuts, packing etc., complete in the existing manifold. Dismantling & re fixing the necessary existing all types of valves, gauges, strainers etc., at delivery & suction manifold complete with all lead and lift as directed by the EIC.

Servicing and commissioning:The pumpsets along with all other electrical equipments shall be serviced and commissioned in the presence of the Engineer-in-charge of work including trail running for a period of 3 days. The work shall include the following servicing and heat running of the pumpsets along with allied equipments. Calibration of switch gears relays and meters giving performance tests of all electrical equipments. Providing operating and maintenance manuals of the pumps and allied equipments to the operating personnel. Giving trail run of the pumpsets for a period of 3 days from the date of successful commissioning. The contractor should train the Board/Municipal Staff to operate the pumpsets.etc., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the EIC.

Repair & reconditioning of existing starter panel : Repair and reconditioning of existing control panel & starter panel units by duly replacing the damaged / burnt suitable make and rating of the necessary existing ammeter, voltmeter, indicators, timers, relays, contactors and connectors etc., complete along with wiring complete with all lead and lift as directed by the EIC.

Dismantling of released existing pump set: Dismantling of existing pump, motor, base plate etc., complete without disturbing the standby running pump sets etc., complete with all lead and lift as directed by the EIC.
